'''Electronic hallucinations''' were a form of illusory perception that could occur in [[droid]]s. When [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] spotted [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] slipping [[R2-D2]] a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] containing a distress message and the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], he first suspected that it may have been one such hallucination.<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>
